title: Hi Freight Desk — Aisha at New Pier Studio…
message:
Hi Freight Desk,

This is Aisha Rahman at New Pier Studio. We need a road collection of 3 pallets of framed prints from our studio at 14 Jalan Maharajalela, Kuala Lumpur, going to 88 Industrial Loop, Johor Bahru. Pickup this Thursday if you can. Weight is about 180 kg.

Thanks,
Aisha
reply: Hi Aisha — I have the customer, both addresses, goods, pallet count, and weight. Can you confirm the pickup date as a calendar day (YYYY-MM-DD)?
